name: Meiji no Mori Mino Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 明治の森箕面国定公園
aliases: 明治の森箕面国定公園
description: Quasi-national park commemorating Emperor Meiji, centered on the Minoo waterfall and forest on Osaka's northern edge — famous for autumn maples and wild monkeys.
notes: Managed by Osaka. A short hike from Hankyu Minoo station reaches the falls.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
businessHours: Open access (park; facility hours vary by season and area)
openingHoursJa: 公園は基本的に自由に訪れられます（施設により季節・時間が異なります）

ja.notes: 大阪が管理。阪急箕面駅から徒歩ですぐのハイキングコースで滝に到着。
